title: Wild Bill Hickok
paragraphs: A family Western adventure series starring Guy Madison as Wild Bill Hickok with Andy Devine as his sidekick Jingles, combining frontier lawman stories with action and humor.

Juvenile/family Western adventure starring Guy Madison as Wild Bill Hickok and Andy Devine as Jingles P. Jones. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 263 dated radio objects through December 31, 1954 plus three undated biography/synopsis reference tracks.

GRH documents the program through Original Mutual production run (April 1, 1951 to December 31, 1954) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] and Syndication/rebroadcast phase (July 17, 1955 to February 12, 1956) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Andy Devine (performer on 188 recordings), Guy Madison (performer on 188 recordings), David Hire (producer on 187 recordings and writer on 3 recordings), Paul Pierce (director on 186 recordings, writer on 62 recordings, and producer on 1 recording), Charles Lyon (announcer on 183 recordings and music on 1 recording), Richard Aurandt (music on 171 recordings, performer on 4 recordings, composer on 1 recording, and conductor on 1 recording), and Larry Hayes (writer on 86 recordings and performer on 1 recording).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include robbery and theft, outlaws and bandits, mining and prospecting, stagecoach and frontier transport, ranching and cattle, and frontier towns and settlements.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Postwar juvenile Western radio boom, Cereal sponsorship and youth premiums, and Parallel radio and television Western franchise.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (74 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (63 shared credited people), [[show|escape|Escape]] (58 shared credited people), [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (51 shared credited people), and [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (48 shared credited people).
